risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and includes meaningful operating and capital expenditure figures, but contains substantial forward-looking qualifiers and boilerplate risk language. Key credit concerns include reliance on revolving borrowings for liquidity, an approximately 80% dividend reduction, lower sales and Plant Nutrition earnings, and indefinite suspension of the lithium project. Improved operating earnings and disciplined sustaining capital expectations partially offset the negative liquidity and execution-risk tone.
